title: Betsy Bobbin & The Lost Princess of Oz
original_title: Betsy Bobbin & The Lost Princess of Oz
overview: In a dance theater production, sailor girl Betsy Bobbin is shipwrecked and stranded in the Land of Oz, where she journeys to find Ozma, the Lost Princess.
